text: This is a really good dentist. I had a toothache and eating anything was painful. The pain was stinging in my tooth for several days. So I had the dentist check if the filling had come loose or if the tooth was cracked. The dentist checked and ground down the tooth that was not even with the lower tooth. I had had the crown done elsewhere, but not at the dentist's office. When it was finished, the dentist didn't charge me. The dentist was very kind. Thank you very much, dentist.
The doctor is kind and gentle.
author_name: สาวิตรี ชีวสุขานนท์

text: I had dental work done by this doctor many years ago, and this year when I return to Thailand, I will be seeing him again for further dental treatment.
The doctor was very kind, and the price was affordable.
Yes, I used their services and they were great. The price was affordable and the doctor gave good advice.

author_name: ขวัญชัย ชีวสุขานนท์
